articleTitle: Why Your Old Deodorant Stopped Working in Menopause
imageSubtext: Menopause changes sweat chemistry. What you need now is different.
pinTitle: Why Your Old Deodorant Stopped Working in Menopause (And What Actually Helps)
pinDescription: Hormonal shifts during menopause change both sweat volume and chemistry—more fuel for odor-causing bacteria. Learn the difference between deodorant and antiperspirant, why clinical-strength formulas work, and the nighttime application trick that makes them more effective.

items.label: Apply to completely dry skin before bed
Give it 1-2 weeks to build efficacy
Step up to aluminum chloride if needed

backgroundScene: A bathroom counter at dusk with soft natural light, featuring a clean towel and a simple stick antiperspirant beside a small potted succulent
